changelog:
v3.7.8 — Live TV Navigation Cleanups

Three small Live TV polish fixes:

• You can now D-pad right from the channel list into the preview pane and press OK to go fullscreen — without losing the channel cursor when you click. Also works after switching categories: D-pad right twice (categories → channels → preview).

• Switching to a new category now starts the channel list at the top instead of keeping the previous category's scroll position.

• After watching a channel in fullscreen and pressing back, the preview pane now reliably restores to the channel you were actually watching — even if you switched channels mid-fullscreen. Backed by the player's stream ID instead of relying on the channel list staying intact.
